consumers.name: des.domain.test_run.test_run_from_envelope
argv:
import json, sys
from des.domain.test_run import test_run_from_envelope

with open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8') as handle:
    envelope = json.load(handle)
try:
    test_run_from_envelope(envelope)
except ValueError as rejected:
    print(rejected, file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(1)

consumers.name: sh.consumer.frozen_field_list_from_schema
argv:
set -e
artifact="$1"
schema="$2"
fields=$(sed -n '/"fields": {/,/^  }/p' "$schema" | sed -n 's/^    "\([a-z_]*\)".*/\1/p')
[ -n "$fields" ] || { echo "could not derive the frozen field list from $schema" >&2; exit 1; }
missing=""
for field in $fields; do
  grep -q "\"$field\"" "$artifact" || missing="${missing:+$missing, }$field"
done
if [ -n "$missing" ]; then
  echo "missing required field: $missing" >&2
  exit 1
fi
